title: Organizing a Team Into Departments | Principles of Management Ep 16
description:
Chai Corner now has two outlets and ten people, but nobody is sure who does what. In this animated lesson we watch Ravi organize his team, and see one org chart rearrange itself into every type of department.

You will learn what organizing means (arranging people and resources, with clear roles, authority and relationships), the 5 steps of organizing (identify activities, group them, assign duties, delegate authority, coordinate), and departmentation: grouping activities into departments by function, territory (geography), product, customer or process.

This is Episode 16 of our Principles of Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.

In this video:
0:00 Two outlets, and nobody knows who does what
0:20 What is organizing?
0:39 The 5 steps of organizing
1:10 What is departmentation?
1:24 Functional, territorial, product, customer and process departments
1:51 Mixing two types
2:04 Quick check
2:17 Recap

Next episode: Staffing.
